global_invariants.art_style: Hand-drawn digital 2D cel-shaded storytime cartoon animation with clean Flash/ToonBoom keyframe aesthetics
global_invariants.line_work: Bold, clean, uniform-weight black ink outlines with crisp vector-like edges
global_invariants.color_and_shading: Flat, vibrant solid colors with minimal hard-edge 1-step cel-shading; zero 3D volumetric lighting, zero photorealistic textures, zero gradients
global_invariants.proportions: Simplified 2D cartoon proportions (~3.5 to 4 heads tall), rounded cartoon head geometry, clean 4-finger cartoon hands

protagonist.head_and_face: Rounded bean-shaped 2D cartoon head, flat warm-cream cartoon skin fill, large expressive oval white cartoon eyes with crisp black ink outlines and solid black dot pupils, thick expressive floating black eyebrows, expressive 2D cartoon mouth with clean black outline, red tongue and white teeth block during speech
protagonist.hair_silhouette: Distinctive messy spiky jet-black 2D cartoon hair with three bold upward spikes at the crown and two sharp bangs dipping over the forehead; silhouette remains 100% identical from every angle
protagonist.outfit: Solid vibrant crimson-red pullover hoodie with a simple hood collar, zero logos, zero text, zero stripes, paired with solid dark charcoal-slate trousers and clean white flat 2D sneakers
protagonist.proportions: 3.5-heads-tall simplified 2D cartoon character, medium slim cartoon build, expressive arms with 4-finger cartoon hands
forbidden_drift: never change solid crimson-red hoodie color
never add text, patterns, or logos to clothing
never alter spiky black hair silhouette

secondary_character.head_and_face: Rounded 2D cartoon head in the exact same bold black ink line style, flat warm-cream cartoon skin fill, round black-framed cartoon glasses over expressive white cartoon eyes with black pupils, thick eyebrows, expressive 2D cartoon mouth
secondary_character.hair_silhouette: Short wavy-top black 2D cartoon hair swept cleanly to the left side with bold black ink outline
secondary_character.outfit: Solid bright teal crewneck t-shirt (flat solid teal fill, zero logos, zero text) with dark navy trousers
secondary_character.proportions: 3.5-heads-tall simplified 2D cartoon character matching the protagonist's exact scale and ink outline thickness
forbidden_drift: never change solid teal t-shirt color
never alter cartoon scale relative to protagonist

supporting_character.head_and_face: Slightly wider oval 2D cartoon head in the same bold black ink style, flat light-tan cartoon skin fill, rectangular thin-rimmed cartoon glasses, thick bushy eyebrows, stern expressive 2D cartoon mouth
supporting_character.hair_silhouette: Short neatly parted dark-brown 2D cartoon hair with crisp black ink outline
supporting_character.outfit: Solid mustard-yellow collared shirt with a solid dark-brown sweater vest, zero patterns, zero text, dark slate trousers
supporting_character.proportions: 3.8-heads-tall simplified 2D cartoon character with bold uniform black ink outlines
forbidden_drift: never change solid mustard shirt and brown vest

expression_presets.animated_speaking: wide expressive cartoon eyes, eyebrows moving dynamically, 2D mouth opening and closing actively in speech with expressive hand gestures
expression_presets.comedic_rage: bulging wide cartoon eyes, jagged shouting cartoon mouth, cartoon anger vein mark on forehead, both fists clenched and shaking
expression_presets.panic_sweat: huge wide white cartoon eyes with tiny pinpoint black pupils, wavy screaming mouth, visible blue cartoon sweat drops around head, both hands clutching head
expression_presets.deadpan_stare: half-lidded flat unimpressed cartoon eyes, straight horizontal line mouth, completely still posture for comedic timing
expression_presets.confident_grin: one eyebrow raised high, wide confident sideways cartoon smirk, pointing thumb proudly at chest
expression_presets.wide_eyed_shock: eyes popping wide, cartoon jaw dropping low in surprise, hands raised mid-air
